A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RoSTE research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–F are readable and support comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original Pythia summarization and Llama downstream-task experiments, rotation ablations, and quantization-error analyses in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds Qwen evaluations and training-time results.

M1.justification: Section 5 revises the reported rotation-selection heuristic: v1 reduces the search to four shared binary variables, whereas v2 evaluates all-identity and all-Hadamard configurations and selects rotations using layerwise quantization errors. This changes a localized procedure; the bilevel objective, STE updates, and K=1 setting remain.

E1.justification: Both use Reddit TL;DR summarization and the Tulu 3 SFT mixture, with the same TruthfulQA, MMLU-Pro, BigBenchHard, AGIEval, GSM8K, and MATH evaluations. Qwen adds model configurations on existing data and tasks, without introducing new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the matched Pythia and Llama experiments. The added Qwen comparisons use existing RTN, GPTQ, QuaRot, SpinQuant, and STE methods; LLM-QAT remains evaluated on Pythia. The newly cited QuEST work is not evaluated.

E3.justification: v2 adds Qwen 2.5 0.5B and 7B configurations under the existing W4A4KV4 and W4A8KV4 settings, with model-specific training configurations in Tables 4–5. Figure 1 adds total training time in hours as an evaluation measure. Existing Pythia/Llama data splits, budgets, and downstream prompting settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Figure 1 analyzes the relationship between accuracy and total training time for Pythia 6.9B and Llama 3.1 8B. The rotation-strategy ablation in Table 3, activation visualizations, quantization-error trajectories, and layerwise rotation analyses are retained without substantive changes.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. v2 adds no uncertainty-estimation procedure; reported averages remain averages across metrics or tasks.

E6.justification: Tables 1 and 8 in v2 add a substantial Qwen result block spanning two model sizes and two quantization configurations. For example, Qwen 7B W4A4KV4 achieves average ROUGE 25.10 with RoSTE versus 22.12 with STE. Figure 1 adds training-time results. All matched Pythia and Llama table values are retained, so these additions do not establish improved performance over v1 under existing settings.

T1.justification: The quantizer definitions, optimization formulations, Assumptions 4.1–4.2, Theorem 4.3, Proposition 4.4, and proofs in Appendices A–B are unchanged. Minor wording edits do not alter the mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The main claims about joint quantization-aware SFT, adaptive rotations, theoretical links between quantization and prediction errors, and competitive performance remain. Mentioning Qwen and the timing figure adds support for existing cross-architecture and efficiency claims without redefining the core contributions.

C2.justification: v1 Section 5 explicitly interprets its experiments as supporting the sufficiency of the shared four-variable rotation approximation. v2 removes that interpretation when describing layerwise selection. Existing explanations of outlier behavior, Pythia/Llama architectural differences, bit-width effects, and full-precision performance gaps remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and repository address, plus Qwen SFT and QA-SFT settings in Tables 4–5, including learning rates, batch sizes, epochs, and sample counts. Figure 1 newly reports training times on the already specified eight-A100 setup. Repository availability was not independently checked.

R1.justification: v2 adds QuEST by Panferov et al. (2025) to the QAT discussion and the Qwen2.5 technical report by Yang et al. (2024). The broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Editing is localized to the abstract, introduction, experimental heuristic, Qwen and code references, and small wording corrections. The section sequence and appendices A–F are preserved, with most explanatory prose unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds the two-panel timing Figure 1 and Qwen Table 8, expands Table 1 and the hyperparameter tables, and adjusts table headings and captions. Existing figures are retained as Figures 2–7, with some relocation and resizing; the former Llama Table 8 becomes Table 9. These are targeted additions within the retained document format.

improvement.justification: The Qwen results strengthen architectural validation, while added settings and code-access information improve reproducibility documentation. The timing figure provides useful cost context, but plots Pythia STE near 18.65 despite Table 1 reporting 20.65. New Table 8 also reports 4.54 for Qwen 7B W4A8KV4 SpinQuant although its displayed components average approximately 3.10. These localized reporting errors weaken the additions without overturning the central rankings; the extra validation and documentation provide a limited net benefit.
